exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Verb not to become".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない
Verb ない ことになる

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Verb ない ことになる matches "Verb not to become".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Verb ない ことになる.
exercises.explanation: Expresses that something will end up not happening or being done.
